_doc: Night Lord skill definitions (spec #383, one marked region per ticket): NL6 #405 Flash Jump (mobility); NL7 #406 moves Lucky Seven and Drain here from skills/thief.json and adds Avenger and Triple Throw; NL8 #407 Ninja Storm and Ninja Ambush; NL9 #408 Shadow Meso; NL10 #409 Shadow Partner. Until a key is defined in a file it is inert: never offered or learned. A key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4), so Lucky Seven and Drain stay in thief.json until NL7. NL2 #401 defined none.

shadow_meso.name: Shadow Meso
shadow_meso.desc: Throws a heavy bag of mesos at the nearest monster. It hits harder the more of the meso charge you hold, and costs no mesos.

text.desc: Throws a heavy bag of mesos at the nearest monster. It hits harder the more of the meso charge you hold, and costs no mesos.
text.h: Damage {damage_percent}% (the bag's meso weight {moneyCon} x 0.6), costs no mesos

shadow_meso._tier: Tier A: the WZ has no damage for 4111004, only moneyCon 135 -> 570 (the average mesos per throw), x 50, prop 1 -> 10 and the three art tiers (the level nodes' ball / hit UOLs change at levels 11 and 21), Use and Hit sounds. Tier C (#408, GAME_DESIGN 7.96): damage% = moneyCon x 0.6 (damage_basis), no mesos spent (ruling D7: moneyCon is kept for the balance pass), +10% damage per held meso-charge pip on top of the meter's own +3% (meter.read_per_unit), swingO1 (the claw's own stance: the node has no action, and shoot1 hides the claw), nearest auto-cast, 3.0 s cooldown, 300 px range, 650 px/s, 10 px radius, no pierce, 0.6 s hold, the echo class, rarity bonuses. x, prop and bulletCount are not modelled (recorded as unused; count is pinned to 1). Untuned.
